parsed_json.up: Select the first 1000 IC50 activity rows for human single-protein target CHEMBL1808. Join activities to assays and target_dictionary to filter by target chembl_id, and join activities to molecule_dictionary then INNER JOIN compound_structures for canonical SMILES. Filter to standard_relation '=' and pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value. Do not deduplicate; keep every qualifying activity row. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit 1000.
